messages.author: 598eae3a5857142f
messages.subject: Distance y-axis labels to y-axis title
parts:
Hi,

is there a way to increase the distance between the y-axis labels and
the y-axis title? In some of my charts they are very close together.
example: http://bit.ly/hy8nDN

Thanks,
Thomas

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Distance y-axis labels to y-axis title
parts:
This seems to be the result of a recent update as I have noticed most of my graphs have similar issues.  I believe you can adjust the positioning of the titles using the hjust/vjust setting in the opts().  

See here for some examples. 

https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/Axis-Attributes

Brandon

messages.author: 598eae3a5857142f
messages.subject: Re: Distance y-axis labels to y-axis title
parts:
Brandon,

p = p + opts(axis.title.y = theme_text(vjust=0,size=24,angle=90))

indeed gives a nice space between them. without size it seems to be
overriding the text size though.

Scott,
\n works too but the space it leaves is massive. (at least with font
sizes of 24 or 32pt)

Thanks guys.

Thomas
